 selected account target and chain.

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

get.description: List known deposit addresses for one account target.

parameters.description:
Optional PolyChain-registered source chain id filter. When omitted, the
 response returns the known deposit addresses for the selected target on
 chains that currently accept deposits, ordered by ascending chain id. A
 chain whose deposits are unavailable returns FailedPrecondition.
